plan.insight: The query scores every key by dot product; softmax turns scores into weights; the output is the weighted mix of values.
plan.user_changes: drag the query and keys, temperature
plan.reacts: weight bars, output point among the values, top weight

components.title: Query and keys (drag)
components.onDrag:
if (id === 'q') return { q: [pos.x, pos.y] };
return { keys: state.keys.map((k, i) => i === index ? [pos.x, pos.y] : k) };

components.title: Weights
components.draw:
const w = softmax(state.keys.map((k) => dot(state.q, k) / Math.sqrt(2)), state.temp);
return [bars(w.map((v, i) => [i, v]), { colors: ['blue', 'orange', 'green', 'purple'], labels: ['K1', 'K2', 'K3', 'K4'] }), ...w.map((v, i) => text(i, v, round(v, 2)))];

components.title: Output = weighted values

components.label: Top weight
components.value: return maxOf(softmax(state.keys.map((k) => dot(state.q, k) / Math.sqrt(2)), state.temp));
